IN A DENSE FOREST LIVED A TORTOISE NAMED TESS WHO DREAMED OF FLYING. WHILE OTHER CREATURES LAUGHED AT HER AMBITION, SHE SPENT HOURS OBSERVING BIRDS AND STUDYING WIND PATTERNS. ONE DAY, A WISE EAGLE NOTICED HER DEDICATION AND OFFERED TO TEACH HER TO FLY. BUT TESS STRUGGLED—HER SHELL WAS HEAVY, AND HER LIMBS WERE NOT MADE FOR WINGS.  

UNWAVERING, TESS PRACTICED DAILY, STRENGTHENING HER MUSCLES AND LEARNING TO GLIDE FROM HILLS. MONTHS PASSED, AND ONE SUNRISE, SHE LAUNCHED HERSELF INTO THE SKY, HER WINGS FATTER AND STRONGER. SHE SOARED HIGHER THAN ANY TORTOISE BEFORE, SEEING THE WORLD FROM A NEW PERSPECTIVE.  

THE MORTALS OF THE FOREST MARVELLED AT HER FEAT, BUT TESS KNEW THE TRUE TRUTH: HER SUCCESS CAME NOT FROM HER WINGS, BUT FROM HER UNYIELDING SPIRIT.  

MORAL: DETERMINATION CAN TRANSFORM THE IMPOSSIBLE INTO THE REAL.
